blank-ds.reason: Project template: the spreadsheet URL is the literal placeholder ADDRESS-OF-YOUR-GOOGLE-SHEET, which the student replaces.

bug-hunting.reason: Ten deliberate bugs for students to find; Bug #1 (`fun h (x):`) is a parse error, so the file is supposed to refuse to compile.

exponents.reason: Equivalence drill: several `examples:` lines (e.g. `expt(2, 3) == (3 * 3) is true`) are false on purpose, so students run it and find which ones fail.

functions-study.reason: `maroon-square` is defined to build an *orange* square while the examples say maroon; finding the mismatch is the exercise.

is-it-16.reason: "Is it 16?" drill: the `examples "A"`/"B" blocks assert that expressions equal 16 when several of them do not. Failing tests are the exercise.

is-it-16-negative.reason: Same drill as is-it-16, with negative bases.

mood-generator.reason: IF-ELSE version ships the stub `fun mood(feeling): "❓" end`, so all four examples fail until the student writes the body. The ASK variant (mood-generator-ask) is the completed one and passes.

negation.reason: Equivalence drill: the `examples:` block asserts negation identities that do not all hold, so students find which ones fail.

negative-exponents.reason: Equivalence drill over negative bases and exponents; some asserted equalities are false on purpose.

snack.reason: Project template: the spreadsheet URL is a "PASTE THE URL ... HERE" placeholder the class replaces with their own survey results.
